title: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Full Length Mock Test 13 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for IAF Agniveer Vayu (Science + Other than Science combined pattern). 100 Questions | 85 Minutes | English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Time: 85 minutes (official combined Science + Other than Science pattern).
Physics and Mathematics 10+2 CBSE level; English 10+2; RAGA includes Reasoning and GK/Defence.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Neither the squadron commander nor the pilots _____ informed of the revised NOTAM.
questions.explanation: When subjects are joined by nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (pilots → were).

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change into passive: The ATC has cleared the aircraft to land.
options: The aircraft has been cleared to land by the ATC.
The aircraft is cleared to land by the ATC.
The aircraft was being cleared to land.
The aircraft had cleared to land by the ATC.
questions.explanation: Present perfect active → has/have been + V3.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The instructor said to the cadet, "Do not leave the cockpit until I signal."

The instructor said the cadet do not leave the cockpit.
The instructor asked the cadet to not leaving.
The instructor ordered that he does not leave.
questions.explanation: Imperative negative → told + not to + V1; present becomes past.
